method: Reverse DCF, bisection solve for the FCF growth rate the current price implies. 10-year explicit forecast, 10% discount rate, 2.5% terminal growth. FCF is trailing twelve months from stockanalysis.com; share count is derived as FCF divided by FCF-per-share; 'cash' is NET cash (cash and short-term investments minus total debt) in $M. Read it as: this is the growth the market is demanding, not a forecast. EXCLUDED by design — pre-revenue and negative-FCF story names (Oklo, NuScale, IonQ, Rigetti, D-Wave, Quantinuum, CoreWeave, Nebius, AST, Hertz, Rocket Lab, Netskope, Energy Fuels), Amazon (TTM FCF is negative on capex), and all banks and insurers (JPMorgan, Goldman, Jefferies, Elevance) where FCF is not a meaningful valuation input.
